visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a man in a black cap and shirt taking a bite of food and making a strained, disgusted facial expression. Bold yellow text overlays appear at the top in a studio-like environment. (2) A series of rapid cuts follow, showing different young men in indoor settings reacting negatively to food. They exhibit squinted eyes, open mouths of disbelief, and hand-to-face gestures. Red and white variety-style text overlays appear at the bottom center. (3) The man in the black cap reappears, holding his throat as if choking, with wide eyes and a distressed look. The lighting is bright indoor. (4) A transition occurs to a different man in a grey shirt making a face of extreme dislike. (5) The man in the black cap is seen again, using a fork to poke at meat on a silver plate, looking deeply concerned. A digital window overlay mimicking an old computer error appears. (6) The video shifts to a positive tone with a change in the top text. The man in the black cap is seen eating a wrap and nodding with a satisfied, calm smile in an outdoor setting. (7) Cuts show other men eating with closed eyes and smiles, expressing enjoyment through head nods and raised eyebrows. (8) The man in the black cap is walking outdoors, holding a piece of stretchy ice cream on a stick, looking up in surprise with a wide-open mouth. Historical buildings are visible in the background. (9) A close-up of a savory meat and vegetable dish in a pan is shown, followed by another man taking a large, happy bite of food. (10) The video concludes with the man in the black cap eating from a small bowl, closing his eyes in bliss, then looking directly at the camera with a warning gesture as text about high prices appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Contrast (Negative to Positive) -> Information -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a high-energy, humorous trailer for a Turkish food vlog, utilizing extreme negative and positive reactions (polarized experiences) to pique viewer curiosity about the range of culinary offerings in Turkey.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands like MADO are visible, the content is structured as a personal travel log/review series rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'high-arousal contrast' strategy, common in short-form social media, where the first half focuses on intense dislike to grab attention before revealing the highly-rated items.
